This would create to much mess for very little gain as both options are good enough. <@429719902363058177> <@226589605816696832> It is good to consider both options in the context of existing implementations. have to agree with lightclient on this one. fees being lost is enough to discourage such transaction from landing in blocks. Isn't MEV/Relay already protecting against it? possibly yes but dont think so, why would it? unless they add such protection after the eip is implemented I mean in general. Aren't they rejecting transactions that fail for their clients? I mostly align with this opinion, both options would do what is expected so it does not matter a lot what is chosen. and after I said sentence above :), about fee argument, my thinking is that anybody can send ill formatted tx and not be penalized for it only incentive for doing so is to do DDOS attack, while having "invalid" transaction in the block and in history is one more error type researchers/indexers need to have. better than adding an infinite list of filters into the transaction pool imo So looks like most people are in fav or current option #1? you already have them, and this additional one is relatively cheap.
